name: Kosuda Nenji
source:
Underling to Vice Principal [url=/c136099]Tanuma Kiichi[/url], always around him. Allegedly serves as the school's guidance counselor, but no one knows what position or subject he actually works at, with Kosuda himself acknowledging as much. He runs errands for Tanuma on daily basis, but otherwise is never seen actually working.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
